# Drift Requirements Quality Checklist: Multi-Window Drift MVP (Option A)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of the Drift state machine and reversibility (Constitution III/V),
multi-window offset drawing and input (FR-005/006/010), delivery-form parity (FR-014) and host safety (FR-015).
Standard depth, for the implementer before `tasks.md` approval.
**Created**: 2026-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the triggers for every state transition (OFF, ENTERING, DRIFT, EXITING) listed in one place, including invalid camera and monitor removal? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, data-model §DriftSession]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the behaviour defined when Drift is enabled while the monitor's active workspace is a special workspace or has no regular workspace? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is it specified what the user is told when ENTERING validation fails (notification content, duration), beyond "notify"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, contracts/drift-control.md]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for unloading the policy plugin while Drift is on (state, offsets, compositor stability)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is it specified whether Drift resumes on a monitor that is removed and later re-added? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are resize requirements defined for Hyprland's own resize bind (for example Super + right button `resizewindow`) in Drift, not only for border drags? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the set of window-owned surfaces that follow `O(w)` complete (main surface, subsurfaces, xdg popups, decorations, X11 override-redirect windows), and are layer popups excluded explicitly? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, research §R8]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 - Is "empty canvas" defined for Super + left-button pan (for example: no window under the pointer after the inverse transform, layer surfaces ignored or not)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "within one frame" for panic defined in a measurable way, given that frames presented are NOT MEASURED in this project (Feature 001 V-08 note)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the zoom direction and step of Super + wheel specified unambiguously (detents, smooth scroll, high-resolution wheels)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, contracts/drift-control.md]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "the build HyprVX was made for" defined per delivery form (commit, patchset id, plugin API hash)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, research §R10]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "restored when Drift is entered again" specific about which camera is restored after a workspace was destroyed and recreated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the X11 override-redirect inheritance rule (parent, focused window of the same client, else 0) stated as a requirement and not only in research? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, research §R9]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 - Is US1.3 ("logical position … equals what it was before, or what Hyprland itself changed meanwhile") consistent with FR-009, which lets floating resize change the size? [Conflict, Spec §US1.3, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK015 - Do the spec (FR-014 "pass the same suite") and the plan (byte-identical captures between forms) state the same parity criterion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, plan §Phases 4]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is "panic does not clear stored offsets" (data model) consistent with the dev-control `panic` that resets offsets, and are both reflected in the product contract? [Consistency, data-model §DriftSession, contracts/test-tooling.md §dev]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are keyboard events consumed by Drift (Super + Escape only) consistent with FR-010, which promises keys reach the focused window? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the fullscreen rule (identity camera, offsets ignored) consistent between spec FR-012, mechanism-api and the T-FULLSCREEN criterion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, contracts/mechanism-api.md]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 - Can SC-001's "window list unchanged" be checked objectively given windows Hyprland itself re-tiles during the test (are such windows excluded or controlled)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is SC-005's anchor tolerance (≤ 1 px over 20 steps) defined as a per-step or cumulative bound? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK021 - Does SC-008 state who reviews, what is signed and where, and which scenario steps are excluded and why? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are the SC-002/SC-003 sample sets (windows, zooms, points) specified enough to be repeated identically in both forms? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §SC-003]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for a window that changes workspace while it is being dragged? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, data-model §Drag]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for input while ENTERING or EXITING (events that arrive during a transition)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is the behaviour of a pointer constraint or lock held by a client when Drift is entered or left specified? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are requirements stated for X11 windows at output scale 1.25 (XWayland scaling), not only Wayland clients? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §SC-002]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK027 - Is "no input interception while OFF" defined measurably (no cancelled events, listeners return immediately)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, research §R4]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are host-safety requirements stated for every new channel into the nested session (virtual keyboard, X11 display resolution, plugin loading)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, contracts/test-tooling.md §4b, §7]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is a per-frame cost requirement or explicit deferral stated for the per-window hint pairs in Drift? [Gap, plan §Complexity Tracking, Constitution VI]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK030 - Is the dependency on DV3-16's open risks (copied functions, private-member access, ABI) stated with what Feature 002 must not make worse? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is the assumption that window offsets and cameras live only for the session reconciled with US1.4 (restore on re-entry) and with compositor restarts? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §US1.4]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the deferral of snap and pin (scenario steps 9 and 10) traceable to the roadmap and visible at the tasks approval gate? [Traceability, Spec §Context, §SC-008]

## Notes

- Items are unchecked by design; checkbox state belongs to the reviewer.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
